subject: Re: Hack the Stack 2027 — platform credit request
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@openrun.org>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Hack the Stack 2027 — platform credit request

Hi Rachel,

Hope youre well — I'm Liam, events lead at the OpenRun Foundation. We're planning Hack the Stack 2027 (April 2027) — a regional hackathon series (~1,200 expected participants across three cities, mostly student and early-stage dev teams). We promote a small set of cloud vendors and infrastructure partners; developers commonly sign up for trial tiers during the weekend.

Quick ask: would Redwood be open to providing platform credits for two things:
- 250,000 tokens of generation credits to be consumed by participant projects at the event (we typically distribute via promo codes)
- three 90-day trial extension promo codes for selected winners/mentors

Wed also be interested in a short demo slot (15 minutes) and a booth. We can feature Redwood as a Community Partner on the event site and social channels.

Attached is a one-page rundown of the event (Hackathon_Rundown.pdf) and a preliminary audience/tech stack doc. If you need a formal SOW or budget line items we can share that.

Timeline: we'd like to confirm partner credits by the end of January to include you in marketing.

Thanks — looking forward to hearing if this is something Redwood can support.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
OpenRun Foundation
liam@openrun.org
[Attachment: Hackathon_Rundown.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@openrun.org>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hack the Stack 2027 — platform credit request

Hi Liam — thanks for the rundown and the invite. This sounds like a good fit for our community grants program. Ill need to loop in Partnerships and Engineering for capacity and then get a formal sign-off from the community grants budget owner.

To move quickly, can you share:
- a short SOW or list of how the credits are distributed (promo codes vs central account)
- expected regional breakdown (SF/NY/London or different cities?)
- whether you need any whitelisting or IP allowlisting for demos

Tentative next steps: Ill route this to our grants committee. Aditya, could you confirm whether 250k tokens is reasonable for a single event weekend (given our Q1 commitments)? Laura, can you advise on approving via Community Grants vs Marketing co-op?

Happy to hop on a 20-minute sync if that helps.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Partnerships (Community Programs)
Redwood Inference
rachel@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hack the Stack 2027 — platform credit request

Thanks for the flag, Rachel. I reviewed the rundown and the ask. Recommendation from Community Grants: approve a partial package now to balance runway and broader outreach.

Approved package (Community Grants Q4):
- 150,000 generation-token credit (allocated as redeemable promo codes)
- three 30-day trial extension promo codes for winners/mentors
- marketing mention (partner) and a demo slot if Partnerships schedules it

Conditions:
- Redwoods promo codes must be redeemed by participant sign-up for the event and are single-use
- we reserve the right to convert any unused credits back to platform pool after 120 days
- please send a one-paragraph blurb for marketing and the final SOW for procurement records

I've attached the signed authorization for the grant (Approved_Authorization.pdf) and linked the budget tracker in the note below. Aditya — please confirm there are no infra constraints for live demos or event-scale redemptions in Apr.

Budget link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cHackathonBudget

Laura Bennett
Director, Partnerships & Community
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Approved_Authorization.pdf (application/pdf)]

Hi Liam — great news: Community Grants has approved a partial package. Summary and next steps below.

What we can provide now:
- 150,000 generation-token credit total (to be distributed as single-use promo codes at your discretion)
- three 30-day trial extension promo codes for winners/mentors
- a 15-minute demo slot and partner mention in event materials

Promo codes (sample) — full list and single-use codes will be delivered as a CSV from our billing team by Jan 20: 
- RT-OR-150K-XXXX (total token pool distributed across codes)
- WINNER-EXT-30-001, WINNER-EXT-30-002, WINNER-EXT-30-003 (trial extension codes)

Action items for OpenRun:
1) Send final SOW or one-paragraph blurb for our marketing listing.
2) Confirm distribution mechanism for the promo codes (email to participants, redemption page, or central admin).
3) Share desired demo time window and any whitelisting requirements.

I'll kick off the promo-code generation with Billing and send the CSV (PromoCodes.csv) and HubSpot partner record by Jan 20. If you want the full 250k ask, we can revisit at the next budget cycle; happy to discuss additional marketing/sponsorship tiers.

Thanks and excited to support Hack the Stack — looking forward to your SOW and the demo logistics.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Partnerships (Community Programs)
